sentences.en: We could barely make out two figures in the dark.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中，我们几乎看不清两个身影。

sentences.en: Brian barely has enough money so he consulted his parents.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩手头的钱几乎不够用，所以他向父母求助。

sentences.en: I barely managed to finish the letter by eleven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我几乎是赶在十一点前完成了这封信。

senses.zh: 勉强才能；几乎不，几乎没有；刚刚；仅仅，只有；贫乏地，光秃秃；<古>公开地，不加掩饰地
